title: A Clearer Clinic Visit
instructions: 这是为A2水平学习者设计的原创阅读练习。请先通读短文，理解大意，然后完成8道题目。题目类型包括单选、填空和判断正误/未提及。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。请根据短文内容作答，不要凭常识猜测。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
A small clinic in the city has a new plan. The clinic wants to help patients understand their health habits. Last month, the nurses saw a problem. Many patients did not remember their doctor's advice. The clinic was busy, so the nurses had little time to explain. The patients were tired, and they forgot the information quickly.

Now the clinic uses a simple information sheet. The sheet has three parts: A, B, and C. Part A is about sleep. It says, "Go to bed at the same time every night. Sleep is important because your body needs rest." Part B is about food. It says, "Eat vegetables every day. Drink water, not sweet drinks." Part C is about exercise. It says, "Walk for 30 minutes a day. Walking is the easiest exercise."

The nurses also ask patients questions. For example, "Do you sleep eight hours? Do you eat breakfast?" The patients answer, and the nurses write the answers on the sheet. The clinic manager says, "This sheet is better than a long talk. Patients can read it at home." The nurses are happy because the patients ask more questions now. The clinic plans to make the sheet shorter next month. It will be the shortest sheet in the city.

questions.prompt: Why did the nurses have little time to explain?
questions.explanation: 短文第一段说“The clinic was busy, so the nurses had little time to explain.”，因此原因是诊所很忙。
questions.evidence: The clinic was busy, so the nurses had little time to explain.

questions.prompt: What does Part A of the sheet talk about?
questions.explanation: 第二段明确说“Part A is about sleep.”，所以Part A讲的是睡眠。

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: Part B says, "Drink water, not ______ drinks."
questions.explanation: 第二段Part B部分写道“Drink water, not sweet drinks.”，因此填sweet。

questions.prompt: How long does Part C say patients should walk?
questions.explanation: 第二段Part C说“Walk for 30 minutes a day.”，所以是每天30分钟。

questions.prompt: What is the best heading for the second paragraph?
options: The Three Parts of the Sheet
answers: The Three Parts of the Sheet
questions.explanation: 第二段分别介绍了信息表的A、B、C三个部分，因此最合适的标题是“The Three Parts of the Sheet”。
questions.evidence: The sheet has three parts: A, B, and C.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The clinic manager thinks the sheet is better than a long talk.
questions.explanation: 第三段中诊所经理说“This sheet is better than a long talk.”，与题目一致，因此是True。
questions.evidence: This sheet is better than a long talk.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The nurses are unhappy because patients ask more questions.
questions.explanation: 第三段说“The nurses are happy because the patients ask more questions now.”，护士是高兴的，与题目相反，因此是False。
questions.evidence: The nurses are happy because the patients ask more questions now.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The clinic will make the sheet shorter next month.
questions.explanation: 第三段最后说“The clinic plans to make the sheet shorter next month.”，与题目一致，因此是True。
questions.evidence: The clinic plans to make the sheet shorter next month.

grammar.title: 原因与结果：because / so；建议：should；比较级与最高级入门
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，表示原因和结果可以用 because 和 so。because 引出原因，so 引出结果。例如：The clinic was busy, so the nurses had little time to explain.（诊所很忙，所以护士们很少有时间解释。）这里 so 后面是结果。注意：because 和 so 不能同时用在一个句子里。should 用来提建议，意思是“应该”，后面接动词原形。例如：You should sleep eight hours.（你应该睡八个小时。）比较级用于两者比较，最高级用于三者或以上比较。规则变化：一般加 -er / -est；以 e 结尾加 -r / -st；重读闭音节双写末尾字母再加 -er / -est；辅音字母+y 结尾变 y 为 i 再加 -er / -est；多音节词前加 more / most。例如：short → shorter → shortest；easy → easier → easiest；important → more important → most important。
grammar.example: The clinic was busy, so the nurses had little time to explain.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The nurse was kind, ______ she helped the old man.
questions.explanation: 前半句是原因，后半句是结果，用 so 连接。
questions.evidence: The clinic was busy, so the nurses had little time to explain.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: I drink water ______ I want to be healthy.
questions.explanation: 后半句是原因，用 because 引出。
questions.evidence: Sleep is important because your body needs rest.

questions.explanation: should 后面接动词原形，不加 to，也不用 -ing。
questions.evidence: Go to bed at the same time every night.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct comparative form: This sheet is ______ than a long talk.
questions.explanation: good 的比较级是不规则变化 better。
questions.evidence: This sheet is better than a long talk.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct superlative form: It will be the ______ sheet in the city.
questions.explanation: 三者以上比较用最高级，short 的最高级是 shortest。
questions.evidence: It will be the shortest sheet in the city.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct comparative form: Walking is ______ than running for old people.
questions.explanation: easy 变比较级时，把 y 变成 i 再加 -er，即 easier。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: You ______ go to bed early. It is good for you.
questions.evidence: Go to bed at the same time every night.

options: Because the clinic was busy, so the nurses were tired.

answers: The clinic was busy, so the nurses were tired.
